ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpEvtMute Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of SharpEvtHook, a tool that tampers with the Windows event logs

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpEvtMute\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "SharpEvtMute" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-Filter\\ \\"rule\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-Encoded\\ \\-\\-Filter\\ \\\\\\.*")))
